id: title:Gilbert09:stop reporting transient db blips from repartition detection

review.posthog_relevance: Reduces false-positive error tracking and unnecessary retry overhead for transient database maintenance blips, preserving system stability and reducing alert fatigue.
review.reason: Adds a transient maintenance error classifier and conditional checks to distinguish database connection blips from genuine failures, while including a test to prevent false-positive error capture. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in reliability and operational hygiene.
review.uncertainty: The actual reduction in false positives and operational benefit is not independently verified; this score relies solely on the implementation and test presence.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned; tier requires assessment of broader systemic benefit and implementation completeness.
